title: hub S5: /update endpoint
description: Full update pipeline (both arms), retry dedup, pending-proposal inclusion (H5), external commit refused while proposals pending (H4), GroupInfo snapshot (H11), fanout enqueue (H17), Welcome destinations (H10, H12). Oracle mls-rs (validity) + mimi-mls Members (policy). Tests: concurrent same-epoch race (one success, one wrongEpoch, tree == winner's); envelope mismatch refused with row counts unchanged (H9); tampered signature no write; policy denial no outbox row; injected post-merge failure restores snapshot. See the .6 design field (approved plan) and decisions .6.1-.6.21.
